newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 futures cut gains, still higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 futures cut gains, still higher.

text.p: June 10 - U.S. June S&P 500 cut gains, stayed higher. Brokers said market could edge back off some but looked for intraday support near 867.20. Contract already slipped back below 870.00 area that it hurdled earlier. They said runup to new record-peak at 872.25 occurred on light dealer buying, local shortcovering, buystops in moderate turnover.
